rollCalls.summary: This bill would require the Commissioner of Correction to collaborate with the Board of Elections to create procedures for curing ballots for voters in the custody of the Department of Correction.

rollCalls.title: Prohibiting the operation of horse drawn cabs and establishing a horse drawn cab industry transition plan, and to…
rollCalls.summary: This bill would wind down the horse drawn cab industry by prohibiting the issuance of licenses for carriage horses, horse drawn cabs, and horse drawn cab drivers on or after June 1, 2028.

rollCalls.title: Establishing a support fund for small retail businesses affected by roadway construction.
rollCalls.summary: This bill would require the Department of Small Business Services (SBS) to establish a program to provide loans, grants, services, materials, or some combination, to support small businesses affected by city construction projects.

rollCalls.title: Returning funds remaining in commissary accounts when incarcerated individuals are released from custody.
rollCalls.summary: This bill would require the Department of Correction to inform persons in custody how much money remains in their commissary account and return all unused commissary funds, in cash, prior to an individual leaving the department’s custody.

rollCalls.title: Streamlining enrollment of eligible individuals in fair fares.
rollCalls.summary: This bill would require the Commissioner of Social Services (Commissioner) to create a streamlined process for individuals to enroll in fair fares.

rollCalls.title: Restrictions on the location of buildings and other structures on Eastern parkway.
rollCalls.summary: This bill would repeal certain building setback restrictions along Eastern Parkway in Brooklyn from Ralph Avenue to Bushwick Avenue.

rollCalls.title: Abatement of taxation for alterations and improvements to certain multiple dwellings.
rollCalls.summary: This bill would extend the J-51 tax abatement for certain alterations or improvements to include projects completed on or after June 30, 2026 and before June 30, 2036.

rollCalls.title: The maximum allowable illuminance of residential outdoor lighting fixtures.
rollCalls.summary: This bill would establish a maximum allowable illuminance of 1 footcandle (11 lux) for certain residential outdoor lighting fixtures.

rollCalls.summary: This bill would expand the City’s outdoor dining program by removing seasonal restrictions on roadway cafe operation.

rollCalls.title: Making the certification of no harassment pilot program permanent and adding criteria for inclusion of certain…
rollCalls.summary: This bill would make the Certification of No Harassment (CONH) pilot program permanent, with a new program list published by the Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) every 3 years beginning on April 15, 2027.

rollCalls.title: Vertical winterization coverings for sidewalk cafes.
rollCalls.summary: This bill would allow sidewalk cafe operators to enclose their year-round sidewalk cafes annually from November 30 through March 31.

rollCalls.title: Sanitation and cleanliness requirements for roadway and sidewalk cafes.
rollCalls.summary: This bill would require roadway and sidewalk cafe operators to ensure that their outdoor setups are clear of trash, debris, graffiti, vermin, food scraps and unsanitary conditions.

rollCalls.title: Establish a temporary program to resolve outstanding judgments imposed by the environmental control board.
rollCalls.summary: This bill would require the Commissioner of Finance to establish a temporary program to resolve certain outstanding judgments imposed by the Environmental Control Board.

rollCalls.summary: This bill would amend the annual disclosure law to affect the bands a New York City officer, employee, candidate for office, or political party official selects when disclosing anything with a monetary value or amount.

rollCalls.title: Workforce stabilization payments for school paraprofessionals, and providing for the repeal of such local law upon the…
rollCalls.summary: This bill would require the Department of Education to provide a workforce stabilization payment, totaling up to $10,000, to each eligible school paraprofessional for work performed during the 2026-2027 school year.

rollCalls.title: Raising the maximum age for taking a civil service examination to become a police officer.
rollCalls.summary: This bill would raise the maximum age at which someone can take the civil service exam to become a police officer from thirty-five years of age to forty-three years of age.
